name: OmaFob
author: Yogesh Ojha
description: TOTP codes in the bar. Import every account from Google Authenticator in one scan.

barWidget.description: Your two-factor codes in the bar, with a ring counting down to the next one. Bring every account over from Google Authenticator in one scan, then copy a code without reaching for your phone.

schema.label: Bar display
schema.description: Icon shows a shield and the countdown ring, and no code until you open the panel. Masked code shows the pinned account as dots that fill in while the panel is open. Code leaves it readable all the time, including in any screenshot you take.

schema.label: Pinned account
schema.description: Which account the bar shows. Matches on issuer or label, so github is enough.

schema.label: Clear clipboard after
schema.description: How long a copied code stays on the clipboard. Nothing is cleared if you have copied something else since.

schema.label: Auto-lock vault
schema.description: How long the vault stays unlocked while you are not using it. With Never you unlock once and it stays open until you log out.
